Tune in to this melodious song Chori Chori Jo Tumse Mili from the super hit movie of 1963 Parasmani starring Geethanjali, Mahipal, Aruna Irani and Helen.
Movie: Parasmani
Singers: Mukesh, Lata Mangeshkar
Music: Laxmikant Pyarelal
Lyrics: Farooq Qaisar
Cast: Geethanjali, Mahipal, Aruna Irani and Helen
Director: Babubhai Mistri
